sections: Convert PDF to PDF/A online

PDF/A is the ISO-standardised version of PDF for long-term archiving. It forbids features that could stop a file opening correctly in decades to come – external fonts, JavaScript, encryption, embedded media – and requires embedded colour information and metadata. Many courts, tax portals, universities and government agencies only accept PDF/A uploads. This converter produces PDF/A-2b on your own device.

PDF/A versions

TIFF vs PNG vs PDF

TIFF is lossless and widely supported by archival and imaging systems; PNG is lossless but rarely accepted by those systems; PDF is better for sharing documents. Convert to TIFF only when a system asks for it – otherwise keep the PDF or use [PDF to PNG](/pdf-to-png/).
